title: Mother with Children, 1950 B&W Family Snapshot Photo
description: A 1950 square black-and-white candid snapshot depicting a mother holding a young child in her arms while a young boy stands beside her, hugging her waist. They are outdoors in a driveway next to a wooden-sided house and yard fence. The front margin features handwritten blue ink annotations identifying the subjects as 'Doris, Wayne & Shirley' and 'Doris + kids', dated 1950. The image captures everyday mid-century suburban American family life.
